prompt_summary: The existing nine plushes plus a 2x2 #D400A8 sheet containing a rainbow pinwheel, star bouncy ball, toy rocket, and connected arcade-cabinet keychain.
post_processing: Removed the border-connected #0000FF matte from the complete 2048x2048 sheet with a 48-level RGB distance threshold before segmentation.
Despilled blue JPEG contamination only within the eight-pixel visible alpha rim; no interior colour correction, dither, warping, or per-frame registration.
Found the three whole plush components with 8-connected alpha components and assigned them by centroid x, preserving the raccoon's connected tail.
Applied one uniform 40% scale to all three trimmed components, centred each on a 320x320 transparent frame, and placed its lowest opaque row at row 300.
Packed the three untrimmed full-size frames into a 3-column PixiJS atlas and recorded baseline 300.

The new sheet used one uniform 40% scale, matching the first sheet's 40% factor; its six source components had comparable native proportions and the resulting bounding heights fit the same 8px-cleared 320px frames.

An initial six-cell generation had pale-pink contamination and an ambiguous hamster, so it was discarded. The final generation explicitly requested a 3x3 sheet with the established first row and a clear hamster; build-prizes.ts cuts only its bottom two rows.

The final generator output used a uniform #D400A8-like matte. build-prizes.ts flood-fills each cell from its border colours (52-level RGB max distance), then keeps the largest connected plush component; no subject pixels are globally recoloured.
The final 2x2 generated sheet was flood-keyed from its border at 70 RGB distance, enclosed key pockets were cleared, and the four largest connected components were extracted in reading order.

The four new components were uniformly scaled to 28% of their source crop, packed into 320x320 untrimmed frames with baseline 300 and 8px edge clearance. Key-coloured alpha pixels were cleared only in the four new frames, including alpha-1 edge contamination.
Packed thirteen untrimmed full-size frames in a deterministic 4-column atlas.

outputs.key: #D400A8, selected because it is absent from the intended subjects; per-frame leftover key-coloured opaque pixels: 0 for all 13 frames

owner_review.note: The nine original frames are pixel-identical to the prior atlas. The four additions read as a cohesive watercolor toy line, with clean silhouettes and no visible matte halos on cream or dark reviews.
